summary.name: Dash
summary.one_liner: Dash is a macOS API documentation browser and code snippet manager that searches offline documentation sets for 200+ APIs and 100+ cheat sheets.
use_cases: build searchable docs for internal projects
give AI assistants up-to-date framework docs
summary.what_it_does: Dash instantly searches over 200 offline documentation sets for APIs, plus over 100 cheat sheets, and keeps downloaded docsets up to date. Its built-in Docset Generator can scrape websites or index local HTML files, and it supports generating docsets from formats such as Swift DocC, Doxygen, Sphinx, Javadoc and others. The snippet manager stores code with tags, syntax highlighting, and placeholders such as @clipboard, @cursor, @date and @time, and text expansion works system-wide. Dash also supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) so AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT can access its documentation.
notable: 200+ offline docsets covering package registries and frameworks, with automatic updates
Built-in Docset Generator for scraping websites or indexing local HTML
Snippet manager with system-wide text expansion and placeholders
MCP support for connecting AI assistants to documentation
caveats: Platform listed is macOS only on this page
Pricing is not stated on the page; one directory lists it as freeware
